issues.reason: Core patterns bars an unstated relation however obvious in the world — "pending family notification" has no possessive marker, so no words put (Possession sk_family_1 sk_victims_1) there.

Names and casing states "Inflection only — never derivation": the deverbal noun "notification" is a different word from the verb and keeps its own form, so the class term must be notification, not notify.

The instruction set covers only a compound's genus and a nominalization's overt of-phrase oblique, not an implicit argument carried by a noun modifier of a deverbal head — the reviewer's own second gap — and (Recipient <notification> <family>) is true of the sentence and uses a licensed role head, so the calibration line makes it acceptable improvisation.

The taxonomic half stands — "immediately" answers when, not how, so Manner is not its natural slot — but the defect half does not: the reviewer's own first gap concedes promptness adverbs have no licensed carrier, Manner is the instruction set's only adverb oblique, and the atom sits inside the strength-0 denial where it puts nothing false in the KB.

gaps_confirmed: promptness / temporal adverbs ("immediately") have no licensed slot — Manner is defined for manner, Time for calendar / deictic / day-part terms

a deverbal event-noun compound inside a pending-adjunct ("pending family notification") — no rule says whether to keep the noun as the witness's class, fuse family_notification and emit its genus, or reify it with roles

an episodic bare-plural subject ("Authorities did not ... release") — the determiner rule routes every bare plural to the generic/rule reading, yet this is one specific past episode, and the group-witness reading used here is uncovered
new_gaps: a not-yet-occurred eventuality named by a nominalization inside a "pending" adjunct gets a bare class atom with no status, whose documented default reading is generic / habitual / dispositional — not "has not happened yet", which is what the adjunct means; no rule covers occurrence-neutral nominalized eventualities
repair_summary: Dropped (Possession sk_family_1 sk_victims_1), the unstated possessor. Re-lemmatized the notification eventuality to its own noun form — class notification instead of notify, witness renamed sk_notification_1 to match the sk_<class>_<n> convention, propagated to the Recipient atom and the Pending conjunct.
